user.title: AI Heating Assistant
user.description: Global sensors, heating period and frost protection. Heating areas are added afterwards.

data_description.outdoor_temperature: Sensor for the outdoor temperature (e.g. a helper combining several sensors). Without it the current temperature of the weather entity is used.
data_description.outdoor_humidity: Optional. Needed for the ventilation recommendation; without it the humidity of the weather entity is used.
data_description.weather: Optional but recommended. Its forecast is used for the nightly heating day decision and the expected sun. Without an outdoor sensor its current temperature is the outdoor temperature.
data_description.pv_power: Optional. PV power (W or kW) as an indicator for sunshine. The solar gain per area is learned from it.
data_description.pv_forecast: Optional, only together with the PV power sensor. Expected PV energy of the next hour (Wh or kWh, e.g. Forecast.Solar) or expected power in one hour (W or kW). Without it the sun is estimated from the hourly weather forecast and the sun position.
data_description.heat_meter: Optional. Meter reading of the heat meter of the circuits controlled here (Wh, kWh, MWh, MJ or GJ, e.g. total_increasing). The AI then sees the measured heat; it is also shown in the dashboard. Seldom and coarse readings are fine.
data_description.season_start: Outside the heating period all circuits stay off (frost protection only) and the AI is not asked.
data_description.season_end: Last day of the heating period, may be in the next year (e.g. 31.03.).
data_description.frost_temperature: Always applies, also outside the heating period and with a switched-off thermostat.
data_description.forecast_trust: Share of the expected PV power the control relies on when it holds back heating (100 % = full forecast, 0 % = only the current PV power counts).
data_description.season_start_day: Heating is possible from this date (e.g. 1 October).
data_description.season_end_day: Last day of the heating period (e.g. 31 March); the period may span the turn of the year.

vacation.title: Vacation
vacation.description: Vacation detection and preheating for the return.

data_description.vacation_entities: Any of these entities being 'on' means vacation (e.g. an input_boolean or a calendar).
data_description.vacation_temperature: Target for all areas during vacation.
data_description.return_entity: Optional input_datetime, timestamp sensor or datetime entity. Heating starts early enough (learned heat-up time) to reach the normal target on return.
data_description.preheat_reserve: Additional time added to the calculated preheating time.

decision.title: Heating day decision
decision.description: Start value of the heating day rule. It is only set here during setup; afterwards theta is learned and the learned value can be edited under 'Heating day decision'.

data_description.theta_start: Heating is needed when the forecast maximum of the day is below this value (e.g. 16 °C). Learned afterwards.

ai.title: AI (Claude)
ai.description: The AI checks the parameters periodically. Without an API key only the local control runs; the nightly run decides with the local rule then.

data_description.api_key: Optional. Without a key the local control runs alone. The key is only stored in Home Assistant and never logged.
data_description.nightly_time: Daily decision whether heating is needed today (also the start of the evaluated day). Runs with and without the AI.

ai_model.title: AI model and budget
ai_model.description: The key was accepted. Choose the model and how much the AI may cost per month.

data_description.model: Model for all AI calls. Prices below are suggestions for the selected model and can be changed.
data_description.monthly_budget: In US dollars, as Anthropic bills. No AI calls once the costs of the month reach this value (until the month changes).

reconfigure.title: Change API key
reconfigure.description: Enter a new key. Empty removes the key and disables the AI.

data_description.api_key: Optional. Without a key the local control runs alone. The key is only stored in Home Assistant and never logged.

reauth_confirm.title: API key rejected
reauth_confirm.description:
Anthropic rejected the stored API key, so the AI checks and the AI part of the heating day decision are paused. The local control keeps running with the learned values.

Enter a valid key from console.anthropic.com (API keys), without spaces. Leave the field empty to go on without the AI.

data_description.api_key: Checked with Anthropic before it is saved. The key is only stored in Home Assistant and never logged.

error.invalid_day_month: Please enter a valid date (DD.MM., e.g. 01.10.); a day like 31.02. does not exist.
error.invalid_auth: Anthropic rejected the API key. Check it at console.anthropic.com under API keys and paste it without spaces. Without a key the local control keeps running.
error.cannot_connect: Anthropic cannot be reached. Check the internet connection, proxy and firewall. The key was not saved.
error.max_below_base: The maximum interval must be at least the check interval (e.g. check every 4 h, at most every 48 h).
error.outdoor_required: Choose an outdoor temperature sensor or a weather entity.

rules.title: Emergency rule
rules.description: Comfort safety net on days without heating.

data_description.emergency_enabled: On days without heating, an area may still heat if the temperature expected after the lead time is long and clearly below its target, without airing.
data_description.emergency_delta: How far below the target the temperature expected after the lead time has to be (at least the switch-on hysteresis).
data_description.emergency_duration: How long the expected temperature has to stay that low (e.g. 45 min).
data_description.emergency_window_quiet: Airing does not count: windows must not have changed for this time.
data_description.force_on_below: Below target by this much the circuit heats regardless of every prediction and the expected sun.

ventilation.title: Ventilation
ventilation.description: Thresholds of the ventilation recommendation. They are start values: the AI ventilation check adjusts them per area from the learned humidity profile of each room (humidity threshold set per area).

data.ventilation_cooling_margin: Minimum distance above target for cooling

data_description.ventilation_min_ah_advantage: Absolute humidity is the water content of the air in g/m³, independent of temperature. Outside air must contain at least this much less water for 'ventilate now' (e.g. 0.8 g/m³).
data_description.ventilation_max_reference_excess: Drying is not recommended if outside is warmer than inside by more than this.
data_description.ventilation_min_cooling_advantage: 'Ventilation useful' if inside is warmer than outside by at least this (not while heating).
data_description.ventilation_cooling_margin: Within the heating period 'ventilation useful' (cooling) is only recommended if the room is at least this much warmer than its target. Not used outside the heating period. Areas without a heating circuit use their initial target.
data_description.ventilation_cooling_min_temp: 'Ventilation useful' (cooling) only from this room temperature on, all year. 0 = off. In addition cooling is never recommended if the outside air would raise the relative humidity of the room above its humidity threshold.
data_description.night_start_hour: Used when the reference is another room: cooling advantage only counts at night.
data_description.ventilation_ai_enabled: All year the AI reviews the ventilation thresholds of every area with a humidity sensor: it learns what is usual in each room, how low the humidity can get and what airing really achieves. Shares the monthly AI budget.
data_description.ventilation_check_interval: First interval; it doubles with every check that changed nothing relevant and starts over when a room stays humid or a value changes.
data_description.ventilation_check_max_interval: The interval never grows beyond this.
data_description.ventilation_energy_rh_per_k: Energy saving: within the heating period airing costs heat, the more the colder it is outside. The humidity must then exceed the threshold by this much per Kelvin outside is colder than the room (e.g. 0.25 %/K: at 21 °C inside and 1 °C outside 5 % more), at most up to 70 %, above which airing is always recommended against mould. 0 = off. Start value, the AI adjusts it per area.

ai.title: AI
ai.description: Model, times, budget and prices. The API key is changed via 'Reconfigure'.

data_description.model: Model for all AI calls. Prices below are suggestions for the selected model and can be changed.
data_description.effort: Claude thinks before it answers. More effort can give better answers but uses more tokens, which are billed as output. 'auto' leaves it to the model.
data_description.nightly_time: Daily decision whether heating is needed today (also the start of the evaluated day).
data_description.check_interval: Base interval of the periodic AI check on heating days (e.g. 4 h). It doubles after every check without relevant change.
data_description.check_max_interval: Upper limit for the doubled interval (e.g. 48 h).
data_description.monthly_budget: In US dollars, as Anthropic bills. No AI calls once the costs of the month reach this value (until the month changes). A check usually costs a few cents, so 5 USD allow about 100 to 200 calls.
data_description.price_input: US dollars per million tokens, as Anthropic bills.
data_description.price_output: US dollars per million tokens, as Anthropic bills (thinking counts as output).
data_description.price_cache_write: US dollars per million tokens, as Anthropic bills.
data_description.price_cache_read: US dollars per million tokens, as Anthropic bills.
data_description.max_output_tokens: Upper limit per answer, thinking included (too low cuts answers off, they are paid but discarded). Also the upper bound of the cost estimate before a call.

decision.title: Heating day decision (experts)
decision.description: Learned threshold, evaluation, learning steps and phase changes of the heating day decision.

data.too_cold_minutes: Too cold minutes for heating need

data_description.theta: Current threshold of the heating day rule: if the forecast maximum is below it, heating is needed. A change replaces the learned value; learning continues from there.
data_description.too_cold_margin: Evaluation: an area counts as too cold below target minus this (airing excluded).
data_description.too_cold_minutes: Evaluation: this many minutes too cold mean heating was needed.

learning_steps.name: Learning steps
learning_steps.description: How much theta and the margin change after an evaluated error.

data_description.theta_step_up: After error A, i.e. it got too cold on a day without heating (e.g. 1.0 K).
data_description.theta_step_down: After error B, i.e. heating ran although it was not needed (e.g. 1.0 K).
data_description.puffer_step_up: After error A for the cold area.

phases.name: Decision phases
phases.description: When the heating day decision moves between AI leads, shared and rule leads.

data.phase_fallback_errors_7d: Rule errors in 7 days for fallback

data_description.phase_shared_min_days: Who decides the heating day: first the AI leads, then AI and rule decide together, finally the rule leads. 'AI leads' -> 'shared' after this many evaluated days (e.g. 14).
data_description.phase_shared_min_agreement: Minimum agreement of rule and AI.
data_description.phase_rule_min_days: Phase 'shared' -> 'rule leads' after this many days in phase 'shared'.
data_description.phase_rule_min_agreement: Minimum agreement of rule and AI.
data_description.phase_max_rule_errors: Maximum rule errors within the period for a phase change.
data_description.phase_fallback_errors_7d: This many rule errors within 7 days move back one phase.
data_description.phase_ai_check_every_days: When the rule leads and is sure, the AI is still asked every this many days.

ai_limits.title: AI limits
ai_limits.description: Minimum, maximum and largest change per check for every parameter the AI may adjust (heating and ventilation).

user.title: Heating area
user.description: One area has one heating circuit (or none for ventilation only).

data_description.name: Name of the area, also used for the device and its entities.

data_description.humidity_sensor: Relative humidity, needed for the ventilation recommendation.
data_description.window_sensors: One or more window/door contacts ('on' = open).

data_description.heater_switch: Switch of the actuator (e.g. a relay). Leave empty for an area with ventilation recommendation only.
data_description.default_target: Target until you change it on the thermostat card.
data_description.min_target: Lowest value of the thermostat card.
data_description.max_target: Highest value of the thermostat card.
data_description.min_on_time: Always respected (protects the actuator). Not learned.
data_description.heating_type: How the circuit heats. A floor stores heat for hours, radiators react within minutes; the AI judges the learned values with this in mind.

start_values.name: Start values (learned later)
start_values.description: Only when the area is created. Afterwards the learned values are edited.

data.dead_time: Dead time until the room warms (start value)

data_description.window_delay: Window open this long pauses heating. The AI may adjust it.
data_description.recovery_time: After closing, heating waits this long because floor and walls often reheat the room. Learned afterwards.
data_description.dead_time: Time from switching on until the room gets warmer; underfloor heating often 30-90 min, radiators 5-20 min. Learned afterwards.
data_description.puffer: Heating day rule: how far above the target an area must be at the nightly run to manage a day without heating (e.g. 0.7 K). Learned afterwards.

data_description.ventilation_rh_threshold: Start value of the relative humidity from which ventilating is recommended (e.g. 65 % for bathrooms); the AI ventilation check adjusts it to the room.
data_description.reference_temperature: Optional, for rooms aired via another room.
data_description.reference_humidity: Required together with the reference temperature.
data_description.ventilation_block_entity: Optional. While it blocks, no ventilation is recommended: a cover while closed (e.g. sun protection down), a climate entity or water heater while not off (e.g. air conditioner running), a switch, binary sensor, fan or similar while on.

draft.name: Draft from other rooms
draft.description: Windows of other rooms whose opening together also cools this area (cross ventilation). Per combination choose the windows that must be open together. As soon as every window of one combination is open, the area behaves as with its own window open: heating pauses after the window delay and waits the recovery time. A combination with a single window triggers on its own.

data_description.draft_group_1: e.g. kids' room + bathroom; a second combination e.g. kids' room + bedroom.

sensor_unavailable.title: Temperature sensor of {area} unavailable
sensor_unavailable.description:
The temperature sensor {entity_id} of the heating area {area} has not delivered a valid value for at least 15 minutes. Without the room temperature the heating circuit stays off, and frost protection cannot work either.

Check the sensor (battery, radio connection, its integration) or choose another temperature sensor in the settings of the heating area. This message disappears by itself as soon as the sensor delivers values again.

actuator_unavailable.title: Switch of {area} unavailable
actuator_unavailable.description:
The switch {entity_id} of the heating area {area} has been unavailable for at least 15 minutes, so the heating circuit cannot be switched and stays in its last state.

Check the device (power supply, radio connection, its integration) or choose another switch in the settings of the heating area. This message disappears by itself as soon as the switch is available again.

actuator_not_responding.title: Switch of {area} does not respond
actuator_not_responding.description:
The switch {entity_id} of the heating area {area} did not change its state after several switching commands. The integration keeps trying with growing pauses (up to 15 minutes).

Check whether the device reacts when you switch it by hand in Home Assistant, and whether another automation switches it back. This message disappears as soon as the switch follows the commands again.

outdoor_unavailable.title: Outdoor temperature sensor unavailable
outdoor_unavailable.description:
The outdoor temperature sensor {entity_id} has not delivered a valid value for at least 15 minutes. The control keeps running, but the prediction is less accurate and the thermal model learns nothing meanwhile.

Check the sensor or choose another one in the settings of AI Heating Assistant (General). This message disappears by itself as soon as the sensor delivers values again.
